PRIOR (general agent knowledge, not SPIDER evidence): a baseline already at the 1.0 ceiling destroys treatment sensitivity, so a non-degenerate task bank is a prerequisite for any inheritance-success claim, not a nice-to-have. Applied to the decision to not fund the four-arm benchmark and to fund the condition-(1) shipped demonstration first.

PRIOR (general agent knowledge, not SPIDER evidence): long-horizon agent reliability decays roughly multiplicatively because early errors become path-dependent, so inherited mechanisms that eliminate decision points should be measured on marginal cost per verified success rather than on route replay. Used only to favour cost-per-success framing, not as an established SPIDER result.

allocation.rationale: Product is IDLE with no active experiment and no mandate; the global state changed because B1 (carrier installation) was discharged, so the lane is REOPENed. This is the audit's objective (1) and the Scout's option (a): a shipped-carrier end-to-end demonstration with one known positive and one known negative. Decision counterfactual: if the shipped treatment executes a never-observed identifier and safely refuses a known negative, readiness condition (1) is discharged and the flagship four-arm benchmark's treatment arm is real and instrumentable; if the shipped path cannot execute end-to-end, the promoted carrier is not product-executable and must be fixed inside Product before any benchmark spend -- a direct, high-leverage fork. It is deliberately NOT the B1 certificate re-run (the parent verdict excludes that) and NOT the four-arm benchmark (conditions (2) and (3) do not hold, and policy forbids funding that execution). Budget/stopping: one bounded credential-free integration experiment; no full-benchmark execution. Second objective held in reserve (not allocated now): first-party persistence-economics instrumentation h(N), Cwrite, Cmiss, which is coupled to Runtime's B2 bank. Cognitive reset performed: because the lane is idle, I asked what Product would do fresh on today's Codex with B1 discharged, and the shipped end-to-end positive/negative demonstration wins over both a mechanism search and an economics run because it is the only blocker Product can remove without B2/B3.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The unified Codex holds 442 canonical Research-2.0 packets plus 1,401 historical artifacts, but product advantage is still unproven: exactly one of ten claims is established (C-MEAS-VALID = VALIDATED, and only inside a bounded authorship-separated Chromium/synthetic-substrate scope). Recent-60 audit friction is 48.3% REVISE/MEASUREMENT_INVALID (29 PASS / 13 REVISE / 16 MI / 2 FAIL); PASS is a disposition, not positive evidence. The decisive change since the last cycle is that Product's long-standing blocker B1 (no promoted parameterized carrier) is DISCHARGED by EXP-PRODUCT-38180719830 (byte-identical carrier, D0-D4+V8 certificate PASS, independent PASS audit, promotion_ready=true, C-PARAM-INHERIT retained EXPERIMENTAL). The flagship four-arm COLD/INSTRUCTIONS/RETRIEVAL/SPIDER benchmark remains correctly blocked on readiness condition (2) (Runtime: non-ceiling multi-step task bank) and (3) (Intel: capable same-protocol endpoint), and condition (1) itself still requires a shipped end-to-end positive-plus-known-negative demonstration that B1 alone does not satisfy. Per policy I therefore fund NO expensive C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON execution and instead concentrate Product, Runtime and Intel on removing the three readiness blockers. Two lanes carry local-attractor flags (physics: C-WEB-DYNAMICS streak 5, 7/10 recent MI; runtime: C-MEAS-VALID streak 69, 10/10 recent on one claim). Both flags are treated as warnings, not quotas: I allow each lane to finish the single bounded decision it is mid-way through, and I bind each to an explicit stop/redirect trigger so the attractor cannot continue by inertia. Four lanes have frozen or pre-freeze transactions that must complete under their designs; I therefore set CONTINUE/USE where the mandate is still the most promising next problem and reserve SUPERSEDE for Product, whose inherited four-arm proposal is not runnable now. Graph's frozen C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE packet is authorized as the deciding test of the deterministic-resolver-vs-structured-slot fork, not another parameterization. Frontier's pre-freeze C-CROSSSITE redesign is authorized because it is the first design carrying the audit's decisive fixes and it self-terminates on unmet preconditions. No lane is left accidentally dormant: Product is explicitly REOPENed.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout brief materially shaped this cycle but was treated as staff advice and challenged against the Codex. I adopted: (a) the brief's central fact that B1 is discharged and that the flagship benchmark stays blocked on B2/B3 — verified directly in EXP-PRODUCT-38180719830 verdict/audit and codex/claim_state.json; (b) its identification of Product as idle and its two reactivation options — I selected the shipped end-to-end condition-(1) demonstration (option a) over persistence-economics instrumentation (option b) because (b) is coupled to Runtime's unfinished B2 bank while (a) is independent; (c) its external context that 2026 systems (QCR arXiv:2608.12847, ColorBrowserAgent arXiv:2601.07262, TraceCompiler arXiv:2608.02680, SkillMigrator arXiv:2606.17645) now publish SPIDER-shaped results, which is why Intel's mandate must produce reproduced denominators and not internal-arm-only comparisons; (d) its reading that physics may not be able to provision a second egress — I bound the physics mandate to fail loudly to BLOCKED rather than substitute a single-vantage run. I rejected, or did not mechanically follow: the brief's questions 5 and 6 as direct allocations (QCR must be a reproduced comparator, not an immediate benchmark; C-DELTA-REPAIR stays behind the shipped/readiness work rather than being force-reactivated now), and I did not PARK Graph's frozen resolver test as the brief's question 4 leaves open — I judged it the deciding fork and let it complete. I did not perform independent broad reconnaissance; I inspected only the exact packets named above plus the legacy index for de-duplication screening.
